slices.title: Add AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the .scratch/ gitignore entry to the skills contract
slices.scope: Adds rows for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the .gitignore .scratch/ entry to the project file contract table in the skills repo, via a PR there. Touches no faber code and no other contract rows.

automated: The contract table in ../skills/.agents/conventions.md lists AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the .gitignore .scratch/ entry
manual: The owner merges the contract PR in the skills repo

slices.title: Scaffold the TypeScript package with pnpm check in CI
slices.seam: CLI in a temp git repo
slices.scope: Adds package.json (name faber, version 0.1.0, engines >=24, bin faber pointing at dist/), tsconfig with rewriteRelativeImportExtensions, biome config, @types/node, a pnpm check script running biome, tsc --noEmit and node --test, a GitHub Actions workflow running pnpm check on every PR, and a faber bin stub with a node --test harness that spawns it in a fresh temp git repo. Implements no init behaviour and leaves the existing prose files alone.

automated: pnpm check passes locally
pnpm check passes in CI on a PR
A node --test case spawns the faber bin in a fresh temp git repo and reads its stdout and exit code

slices.title: Create every project file in an empty repo
slices.seam: CLI in a temp git repo

automated: In a temp git repo, the first faber init prints created for spec/vision.md, spec/glossary.md, .agents/coding-standards.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and .gitignore, in that fixed order, and each file exists
The run ends with next: fill spec/vision.md and .agents/coding-standards.md, then commit
git status after a run shows no staged changes and no new commit

slices.title: Fill the templates with the headings the skills read
slices.seam: CLI in a temp git repo

automated: The created spec/vision.md holds ## Product principles and ## Current direction, each followed by a <!-- hint --> line
The created .agents/coding-standards.md holds ## Rules and ## One-way doors

The created AGENTS.md points at spec/vision.md, spec/glossary.md and .agents/coding-standards.md, states the spec/features/<slug>/ planning rule and that the vision is the owner's, and has an empty ## Rules
The created CLAUDE.md holds @AGENTS.md
manual: The owner runs faber init on a real repo of his and judges whether the templates read well before filling

slices.title: Keep existing files on a second run
slices.seam: CLI in a temp git repo

automated: A second run prints only kept lines and leaves every file byte-identical
.gitignore is created when missing and holds .scratch/
An existing .gitignore without .scratch/ gets it appended and keeps its prior content
.gitignore holds .scratch/ exactly once after repeated runs

slices.title: Respect contract fallbacks and an existing CLAUDE.md
slices.seam: CLI in a temp git repo

automated: With CODING_STANDARDS.md present, the run prints kept CODING_STANDARDS.md (fallback) and creates no .agents/coding-standards.md
With GLOSSARY.md present, the run prints kept GLOSSARY.md (fallback) and creates no spec/glossary.md; the same with CONTEXT.md
With a CLAUDE.md lacking @AGENTS.md, the run prints kept CLAUDE.md and warn CLAUDE.md does not import @AGENTS.md, and the file stays byte-identical

slices.title: Write at the git root or refuse outside git
slices.seam: CLI in a temp git repo

automated: A run from a subfolder writes every file at the git root and none in the subfolder
A run outside a git repo exits non-zero, prints a message saying it is not in a git repo, and writes nothing

slices.title: Install faber from a packed tarball and publish it
slices.seam: CLI in a temp git repo

automated: A tarball from npm pack, installed into a scratch folder, runs faber init from node_modules/.bin/faber against a temp git repo and creates the files
The tarball holds dist/ and templates/ and no .ts sources
A changesets release workflow runs changesets/action with npm trusted publishing and no stored npm token
manual: The owner does the first npm publish of 0.1.0
